title: Pullback of the integral line-bundle class before passage to towers
statement: Let f : X → Y be arbitrary, L an invertible Y-module, and a : f_proet^* G_m,Y → G_m,X whose adjoint pulls back units along every chart projection. The ordinary derived lineBundleEtaleClass [def-sp-tower-class-reduction] of Pic.ofIsInvertible L, mapped by f_proet^* and followed by a[1], is the constant-integer pullback map followed by lineBundleEtaleClass of Pic.ofIsInvertible (f*L). The canonical exact-functor single and shift comparisons are supplied by mapSingleArrow. No tower or flatness hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Use the already proved gmCohomologyMap_toCohomologicalPicardGroup for f and Pic.ofIsInvertible L. The canonical skeleton representative isomorphism and its module pullback identify Pic.map f (Pic.ofIsInvertible L) with Pic.ofIsInvertible (f*L). Substitute this equality into lem-sp-integral-cohomology-site-pullback. Unfolding lineBundleEtaleClass gives precisely the stated ordinary derived identity.

theorem lineBundle_proEtaleClass_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L : Y.Modules) [Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible L]
    (a : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj (Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf Y) ⟶
      Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf X)
    (ha : ∀ (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf Y).obj.obj U),
      (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).homEquiv _ _) a).hom.app
          U x = ULift.up (Additive.ofMul
          (Units.map (pullback.fst U.unop.hom f).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom x.down.toMul))) :
    mapSingleArrow (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f) 1
        (lineBundleEtaleClass Y (Scheme.Pic.ofIsInvertible L)) ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).map a)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).map
          (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).homEquiv _ _).symm
            (Scheme.proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))) ≫
        lineBundleEtaleClass X
          (Scheme.Pic.ofIsInvertible ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L))
